title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil spike capped stocks, semis crushed.  
WTI +6.73% reignited inflation fears, 10Y yield up ~6bps to 4.70%, dragging QQQ -0.30% and SOXX -2.55% while XLE +4.66% led. Breadth stayed flat (SPY -0.03%) — energy surge absorbed rate-sensitive losses, leaving a defensive-commodity tape.

INDICES — VIX 15.5, below 20d MA 17.1. Return ranking: DIA -0.12%, SPY -0.03%, QQQ -0.30%, IWM -0.52%, SOXX -2.55%. Large > small by 0.49pp. Notable cross-asset: USO +6.73%, TLT -0.85%. SPY above 200d, QQQ above 200d.

VOLUME — SPY vol 0.9x, QQQ 0.7x — both fading. XLE 1.2x and OIH 2.2x rising with prices = accumulation in energy. GLD/SLV 1.5x volume with price gains = metals accumulation. QQQ volume down + price down = uninspired tech selling.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLE Energy +4.66%, XLV Healthcare +1.67%, XLB Materials +0.61%, XLC Comms +0.52%, XLF Financials +0.36%, XLY Discretionary -0.16%, XLP Staples -0.20%, XLI Industrials -0.31%, XLK Technology -0.88%, XLU Utilities -1.10%, XLRE Real Estate -1.29%. Top industries: USO +6.73%, OIH +5.94%; bottom: SOXX -2.55%, JETS -3.38%. Money into energy/healthcare, out of tech/rates — label: 'broad risk-on' shifting to commodity-led defensive bid.

POSITIONING — QQQ PCR_vol 1.42, elevated protection; skew +7.6% shows put premium. GEX flip 730 vs QQQ spot — above flip, dealer hedging dampens downside. VIX below 20d MA = complacency despite SOXX -2.55%. MOVE 75.5 above 20d 69.9 — bond vol stress rising.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +6.73% vs JETS -3.38% — transmission through jet fuel costs. Gold +1.02% and silver +3.32% rising with oil — commodities as inflation hedge while rates-backed XLU -1.10% and XLRE -1.29% bleed.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Greed 62.7. Movers: MP +6.95% on Q2 earnings revenue up 89%, PANW +5.82% on institutional positioning, FANG +5.81% on Wells Fargo forecast. Energey momentum extreme: XLE 20d +6.06%. Watch: SOXX -2.55% below 20d MA -4.37% with volume spike accelerating — trend break; XLU -1.10%, 20d -5.66%, volume 1.4x diverging — distribution; NET +3.44% at 2.4x vol, accumulation signal.
